abstract: Previous studies have established that embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells produce several different growth factors, but express few, if any, receptors for epidermal growth factor, platelet-derived growth factor, or transforming growth factor type-beta. In this study, the production and utilization of fibroblast growth factor (FGF) by EC cells and their differentiated cells were investigated. We have determined that EC cells produce a heat-labile, heparin-binding factor that competes with FGF for binding to membrane receptors and appears to be immunologically related to FGF. The same or a similar factor is produced by three different EC cell lines, including a multipotent human EC cell line. However, production of this factor is apparently reduced when each EC cell line differentiates. Unlike the parental EC cells, the differentiated cells respond to FGF by growth stimulation and the growth responses to FGF correlate with increased binding of FGF. Although the binding data indicate that both the EC cells and their differentiated cells exhibit high affinity receptors for FGF, the differentiated cells express these receptors at levels approximately 10-fold higher. These findings suggest that the FGF-related growth factor could influence the growth of EC cells or their differentiated cells.
abstract_ja: これまでの研究で、胎児性癌(EC)細胞はいくつかの増殖因子を産生するが、上皮増殖因子、血小板由来増殖因子、TGF-βの受容体はほとんど発現しないことが示されている。本研究では、EC細胞とその分化細胞におけるFGFの産生と利用を検討した。EC細胞はFGFの膜受容体への結合と競合し、FGFと免疫学的に関連すると考えられる、熱に不安定でヘパリン結合性の因子を産生していた。同じ因子あるいは類似の因子が、多能性のヒトEC細胞株を含む3種のECセルラインで産生されていた。ただし、いずれのEC細胞株も分化すると、この因子の産生は明らかに低下した。親のEC細胞とは異なり、分化細胞はFGFに応答して増殖が促進され、その増殖応答はFGF結合の増加と相関していた。結合実験では、EC細胞と分化細胞の両方が高親和性のFGF受容体を持つことが示されたが、分化細胞では受容体の発現量がおよそ10倍高かった。これらの知見は、FGF関連増殖因子がEC細胞あるいはその分化細胞の増殖に影響しうることを示唆する。
